description: This file defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) class 'InterestPauseRequestDto' used to encapsulate data for creating an interest pause, including start/end dates, locale, and date format. It also provides methods to serialize/deserialize the object to/from JSON.

classes.name: InterestPauseRequestDto
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object for interest pause requests with fields for start/end dates, locale, date format, and methods for JSON serialization and deserialization.

methods.name: toJson

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON string into an InterestPauseRequestDto instance. Throws IllegalArgumentException on failure.
